status: Unpublished release candidate. Not on npm, under this or any other name. Install from the versioned archive at https://zodiacs.org/examples/, whose SHA-256 is published beside it.

bundled.note: Engine 0.1.1-rc.17 and the site comparison are inlined into server.mjs. That engine is a release candidate that is not on npm, where 0.1.1-rc.16 is under the next tag; the bundle is built from the archive whose SHA-256 is below, carried in the engine repository. Bundling keeps one copy of the comparison rules.

comparison.note: The same module the browser tool at https://zodiacs.org/developers/compare/ runs.

computeApi.note: The hosted compute API's parsers and positions, events and sky-fact calculations, inlined into server.mjs, so get_positions, find_events and check_sky_fact return what POST https://zodiacs.org/api/v1/positions, /events and /sky-fact return for the same request, without a zone.

protocol.note: Revisions observed to negotiate against this server on the wire, one probe each. The official SDK client offers 2025-11-25.

schemas.note: Zodiacs-owned vocabulary, not an industry interoperability standard. The record and receipt schemas are drafts.

changedSince: rc.1 to rc.10, rc.14, rc.15, rc.16 and rc.16.1 to rc.16.3 remain unchanged as separate archives; there were no rc.11 to rc.13 archives. The engine is 0.1.1-rc.17, a release candidate that is not on npm. It adds the sidereal zodiac to @zodiacs/engine/calc, which this adapter does not bundle. The parts it does bundle are rc.16's apart from the version string and comments naming chunk files, so every position, angle, cusp, event, fact and comparison is rc.16.3's. New in rc.17: get_capabilities labels the engine unpublished-candidate, with no registry, where rc.16.1 to rc.16.3 labelled 0.1.1-rc.16 published on npm. The server information, get_capabilities, the receipts, the cites, the methodology resource and the line the server writes when it starts name the two new versions, and the cite.receipt digests over those receipts change with them. Apart from the label, the versions and those digests, every tool's arguments, results and refusals are rc.16.3's, over the 278 calls of docs/platform/evidence/site-engine-rc17/mcp-rc16.3-rc17.json. verify.mjs, the install check a downloader runs, now checks the engine's label against this archive's candidate.json; it expected the label of an engine on npm, and rc.17's would have failed it. The adapter itself is still not on npm.
